title: lomaria triloba
intro: Lomaria triloba, commonly known as the three-lobed fern or trilobed fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as treating respiratory issues, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Lomaria triloba include its ability to treat bronchitis, coughs, and fever, as well as its antispasmodic and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
